discussion.title: Migration guide
discussion.author: ann
discussion.body:
This guide explains how to move from the old policy to the new checks without downtime.

You could instead construct the check like so:

```python
check = build_check(deadline="0 9 * * *")
```

## Why this change

The old policy computed data time in a way that confused many users and could not be overridden.

F.A.Q.

- Will the old policy be removed? Yes, two releases later.
